chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'Sometimes I hit the slave for something which is prohibited.' He said, 'And how much do you hit him?' I said, 'Sometimes I hit him one hundred times.' He said, 'One hundred, one hundred?' He repeated that twice. Then he said, 'The penalty (Hadd) of the adulterer, fear Allah.' I said, 'May I be sacrificed for you, so how much is befitting for me that I should hit him?' He said, 'One.' I said, 'By Allah, if he knows that I would not hit him except for one, he would not leave anything for me except that he would spoil it.' He said, 'So, twice.' I said, 'May I be sacrificed for you, this is my destruction.' He said, 'So I did not stop haggling with him until it reached five. Then he got angry and said, 'O Is'haq! If you know the penalty (Hadd) of what crime has been committed, so establish the penalty (Hadd) for him, and do not exceed the penalties (Hudud) of Allah.'

key_terms.حَدَّ الزِّنَى: The fixed legal penalty for adultery

ai.seo_question: What is the maximum number of strikes a master should give a slave for discipline according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narrative from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) engages in a dialectical exchange with Isma'il ibn Ammar, progressively reducing the excessive punishment of a hundred strikes to five, illustrating the principle of moderation in *Ta'zir* (discretionary discipline). The Imam clarifies that while the master has authority, he must not confuse his disciplinary power with the fixed legal penalty (*Hadd*) for Zina, thereby warning against arbitrary excess. This hadith is frequently cited by Shia jurists to establish the upper limit of reasonable corporal punishment for slaves or children, emphasizing that discipline should be corrective rather than punitive.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Sometimes I hit the slave regarding something which is Prohibited’. So heasws said: ‘And how much do you hit him?’ So I said, ‘Sometimes I hit him one hundred (hits)’. So heasws said: ‘One hundred, one hundred?’ So heasws repeated that twice. Then heasws said: ‘The Penalty (Hadd) of the adulterer, fear Allahazwj’. So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! So how much is befitting for me that I should hit him?’ So heasws said: ‘One’. So I said, ‘By Allahazwj! If he comes to know, that I would not be hitting him except for one, he would not leave anything for me except that he would spoil it’. So heasws said: ‘So, twice’. So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws! This is my destruction’, when heasws said it. So I did not stop haggling until it reached five. Then heasws got angered, so heasws said: ‘O Is’haq! If you know a Penalty (Hadd) of what crime has been committed, so establish the Penalty (Hadd), and do not exceed the Penalties of Allahazwj!’
